refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback prioritizes (1) adding detailed organization information (contact info, legal form, VAT ID, etc.) to improve CQ5 coverage, and (2) formally representing mandatory/optional status of invoice elements (via OWL cardinality or SHACL) for CQ13. Medium priorities: (3) introduce GCAs/equivalence axioms for key roles (e.g., Buyer as an assignment with hasRole Buyer and inInvoice), and (4) add OWL restrictions (cardinality, value constraints) for main structural properties. Low priority: (5) extend disjointness axioms to AgentRole subclasses. Plan: (1) Add new properties/classes for organization details (contactName, email, phone, vatID, legalForm, etc.), (2) Add cardinality restrictions (owl:cardinality, owl:minCardinality) for mandatory fields (invoiceNumber, issueDate, header/detail/summary, at least one buyer/seller, at least one line item), (3) Define GCAs/equivalence for Buyer, Seller, DeliveryParty, (4) Add disjointness for AgentRole subclasses. Annotate all new elements. Preserve all existing correct structures.
